## Retention Schedule by Document Type  
### Customer & Account Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Legal Basis | Destruction Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Customer Profile** | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, AML, dispute | Shred/delete |
| **KYC/CDD Records** | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs 2017 | Shred/delete |
| **Identification Docs** | 6 years post-closure | POCA, anti-fraud | Shred/delete |
| **Address Verification** | 6 years post-closure | KYC requirements | Shred/delete |
| **Account Opening Forms** | 6 years post-closure | Contract evidence | Shred/delete |
| **Statements** | Account tenure + 6 years | Customer service, disputes | Shred/delete |
| **Transaction Records** | 6 years minimum | POCA, audit, disputes | Shred/delete |
| **Standing Orders** | Account tenure + 2 years | Contract evidence | Delete |
| **Direct Debit Mandates** | 6 years post-cancellation | DD scheme rules | Shred/delete |

raw_entities.name: Data Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the retention and destruction of customer, account, and transaction documents across multiple document types. The policy specifies retention periods ranging from 2 to 6+ years post-closure or account tenure, with legal bases tied to POCA, AML regulations, and KYC requirements. Destruction methods include shredding and deletion.
context: Retention Schedule by Document Type

raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of customer profile documents for the duration of account tenure plus 6 years, with legal basis in POCA, AML, and dispute resolution obligations.
context: Customer Profile | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, AML, dispute | Shred/delete

raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of Know Your Customer and Customer Due Diligence records for 5 years following account closure, with legal basis in the Money Laundering Regulations 2017.

raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of identification documents for 6 years following account closure, with legal basis in POCA and anti-fraud obligations.
context: Identification Docs | 6 years post-closure | POCA, anti-fraud | Shred/delete

raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of address verification records for 6 years following account closure, with legal basis in KYC requirements.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Record Retention Requirement

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Record Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of standing order records for the duration of account tenure plus 2 years, with legal basis in contract evidence requirements.
context: Standing Orders | Account tenure + 2 years | Contract evidence | Delete

properties.core_policy_statement: Bank maintains documented retention schedules for customer and account documents, with destruction methods specified by document type and legal basis
properties.scope_summary: Applies to customer profiles, KYC/CDD records, identification documents, address verification records, account opening forms, statements, transaction records, standing orders, and direct debit mandates

properties.key_obligation: retention of records for money laundering and proceeds of crime investigation purposes
properties.how_cited: legal basis for customer profile, identification document, and transaction record retention

properties.key_obligation: retention of KYC and CDD records for 5 years post-closure; retention of customer profile records
properties.how_cited: legal basis for KYC/CDD records and customer profile retention

properties.key_obligation: retention of direct debit mandates for 6 years post-cancellation
properties.how_cited: legal basis for direct debit mandate retention

properties.risk_definition: financial crime involving concealment of proceeds from illegal activity
properties.required_response: maintain customer profile and transaction records for investigation and compliance purposes
properties.reporting_obligation: regulatory authorities under POCA and Money Laundering Regulations 2017

properties.risk_definition: unauthorized or deceptive transactions and account misuse
properties.required_response: maintain identification documents and transaction records for investigation and dispute resolution
properties.reporting_obligation: internal fraud investigation teams and regulatory authorities as required

properties.performed_by: records management team or system administrator

properties.verification_method: physical inspection or digital verification at account opening
